en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Hadeed, from Ali Bin Al Numan, raising it, said,

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, whenever he<sup>asws</sup> ascended Al-Safa, faced the Kabah, then raised his<sup>asws</sup> hand, then he<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Forgive me<sup>asws</sup>, every sin that I<sup>asws</sup> have sinned. So if I<sup>asws</sup> were to return (to sinning), then Return to me<sup>asws</sup> with the Forgiveness, for You<sup>azwj</sup> are the Forgiver, the Merciful.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Deal with me what You<sup>azwj</sup> are Rightful of, for if You<sup>azwj</sup> were to deal with me what You<sup>azwj</sup> are Rightful of, You<sup>azwj</sup> would be Merciful with me; and if You<sup>azwj</sup> were to Punish me, so You<sup>azwj</sup> are needless from Punishing me, and I am needy to Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy. So, since I am needy to Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy, be Merciful to me.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Do not Deal with me<sup>asws</sup> what I<sup>asws</sup> am deserving of, for if You<sup>azwj</sup> were to Deal with me<sup>asws</sup> what I<sup>asws</sup> am deserving of, You<sup>azwj</sup> would Punish me, and would not be oppressing me<sup>asws</sup>. I<sup>asws</sup> have come to be fearful of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Justice, and I<sup>asws</sup> do not fear Your<sup>azwj</sup> Inequity, since the one who is Just would not be tyrannical. Be Merciful to me!’
en.sarwar: 5. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ali ibn Hadid from Ali ibn al-Nu’man in a marfu‘ manner the following: “

’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, when climbing on al-Safa’, would face the Ka‘bah, raise his hands and then say, ‘O Allah, forgive my every sin that I have committed. If I will return to sin, return to me with forgiveness, You are Forgiving and Merciful.

O Allah, do for me what is worthy of You to do for me; if You do for me what is worthy of You to do for me, You will have mercy on me; but if You punish me, You do not need to do so. I however, need Your mercy. O the One whose mercy I need, grant me kindness and mercy.

O Allah, do not do to me what is worthy of me; if You do for me what is worthy of me, You will punish me and in doing so You will not be doing any injustice to me. I am anxious of Your justice but I am not afraid of Your injustice. So, O the One who is just and never does injustice to anyone, be kind and merciful to me.’”
